title: Ordino, descrivo, mi presento
summary: Week 4 capstone: order food, describe your tastes, and grow your self-intro with food likes and a modal wish.

blocks.title: Settimana 4: a tavola
blocks.body: You can now navigate an Italian meal start to finish: **colazione/pranzo/cena** and *il primo/il secondo*, ordering with **vorrei / per me / mi porta… / il conto**, the modal engine **potere/volere/dovere**, the *piacere* trap (**mi piace** vs **mi piacciono**), and market quantities (*un etto, un chilo*). Today you use all of it — and grow *il mio racconto* one more layer.
blocks.callout: Four weeks of A1 down. This is the last stop before the past tense arrives in Week 5.

items.nl: Un etto di prosciutto, per favore.
items.speak: Un etto di prosciutto, per favore.

blocks.prompt: Which is correct for 'I must go'?
blocks.explain: *Devo andare* — obligation, not desire or permission.

blocks.prompt: How do you say 'I like the tortellini' (plural)?
blocks.explain: *Tortellini* is plural, so *piacciono* — it agrees with the thing liked, not with 'I'.

pairs.note: Both take a plain infinitive: *vorrei provare* / *devo tornare*.

blocks.prompt: Type 'Could you bring me the bill?'
blocks.explain: *Mi porta il conto?* — the same polite request pattern as asking for the menu.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type the whole line.
blocks.speak: Un chilo di mele, per favore.
answers: un chilo di mele, per favore
un chilo di mele per favore

blocks.title: Tutta la settimana in tre frasi

lines.en: I'd like the first course, please.

lines.nl: Devo andare, ma prima il conto.
lines.en: I have to go, but first the bill.

blocks.scene: You, Giulia, and Marco order a full lunch together at a trattoria in Bologna

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.en: So, what do you want to order today?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Vorrei il primo — le tagliatelle al ragù.
lines.en: I'd like the first course — tagliatelle with ragù.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Ottima scelta. Per me un secondo, la cotoletta.
lines.en: Great choice. For me a second course, the cutlet.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Mi piacciono tantissimo le tagliatelle qui.
lines.en: I really like the tagliatelle here.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.nl: Anche a me piace questo posto. Prendiamo anche un contorno insieme?
lines.en: I like this place too. Shall we also get a side to share?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Sì, e alla fine mi porta il conto, per favore?
lines.en: Yes, and at the end could you bring me the bill, please?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Guarda, ormai ordini come un vero bolognese.
lines.en: Look, you order like a real Bolognese now.
lines.spotlight: Four weeks in and the modal + piacere + ordering patterns all show up in one exchange.

blocks.prompt: Il mio racconto — livello 4! Extend your growing self-intro: keep your name, where you're from, your daily routine, and your family & quartiere — then add what you like to eat and drink, plus a polite wish with vorrei or mi piacerebbe. Write at least 4 sentences. Complimenti — hai finito le basi del cibo!
